info.name: Hoang Nguyen
info.headline: VP of Engineering | AI-Native Engineering, Agent Infrastructure, Distributed Systems

summary: VP of Engineering with 13+ years building distributed systems and leading organizations of 60+ engineers across Product Engineering, Platform, Data, Infrastructure, and QA. Owned the transition to AI-native engineering through shared agent infrastructure and an Agentic Software Factory, which doubled engineering velocity across the organization. Delivered USD 2M in annual cloud savings at 99.99% uptime and led engineering teams in Singapore and Vietnam supporting products across 13 markets.

recognition.detail: Creator of AI DevKit, the open-source control plane for AI coding agents (23,000+ downloads, 1,600+ GitHub stars)
Author of "AI Changes the Tools, You Still Own the Craft" (5,000+ downloads)
Best Product, Marketing Category, Facebook Hackathon Vietnam

projects.name: Agentic engineering
projects.description: Lead ShopBack's Agentic Software Factory and shared agent infrastructure across Product Engineering, Platform, Data, Infrastructure, and QA.
responsibilities: Owned and drove ShopBack's transition to AI-native engineering, building the shared agent infrastructure and Agentic Software Factory that doubled engineering velocity across the organization.

Designed the ticket-to-draft-MR operating model: agent-ready tickets, context packs, repository documentation, sandboxed execution, generated code and tests, evidence-backed merge requests, and human review.

Established risk-based verification standards for AI-generated changes, with stricter testing, review, and rollback requirements for money movement, identity, cashback, payments, and other critical systems.
Lead teams building domain agents for QA, Web, Cashback, Infrastructure, and Data, while staying hands-on with Codex, Claude Code, architecture reviews, production debugging, and system design.

projects.name: Engineering organization
projects.description: Led 60+ engineers in Singapore and Vietnam across Product Engineering, Platform, Data, Infrastructure, and QA, supporting products across 13 markets and partnering with executive leadership on strategy, staffing, investment, and execution.
responsibilities: Architected a multi-tenant runtime that consolidated workloads from 200+ services into fewer than 10 shared Node.js processes, saving USD 2M annually in AWS costs while maintaining 99.99% uptime.
Reduced idea-to-production time from weeks to under 10 days through webview delivery and offline data platforms that removed app-release and engineering dependency bottlenecks.
Led engineering for ShopBack's US launch, delivering market-specific capabilities in 90 days, then created a repeatable launch model that reduced subsequent market rollout time to under two weeks.
Led the web platform migration to a Next.js monorepo, cutting operating costs by 90% and reducing feature launch time from weeks to days.

projects.name: Vietnam engineering
projects.description: Built and scaled ShopBack's Vietnam engineering organization, setting its technical direction, hiring bar, operating model, and engineering culture.
responsibilities: Rebuilt the global engineering hiring process and developed an internal pipeline of managers, staff engineers, and domain owners; engineering headcount grew 39%.
Raised Vietnam engineering's engagement score from 48% to 80% in one year through clearer expectations, stronger management practices, and consistent follow-through on team feedback.
Built systems that made merchant onboarding and campaign management 60% faster across the company.
Delivered 26 global product launches, including the Cashback Platform across 11 markets, and reduced cashback tracking time to 30 minutes.

projects.name: Core platform modernization
projects.description: Led senior engineers building and modernizing core product and platform systems.
responsibilities: Led the extraction of core services from a monolith into Kubernetes-based microservices, owning service boundaries, migration strategy, technical debt, and reliability trade-offs.
Built the Service Operation Platform for seven countries, with multiple React applications, shared authentication, access control, audit logging, and country-level feature gates.
Worked with product, design, and business leaders to connect architecture decisions to product outcomes, and created a structured engineering interview process.

projects.name: Kobiton
projects.description: Kobiton is a cloud platform for running manual and automated tests on physical mobile devices.
responsibilities: Managed the five-person portal team and owned architecture decisions across frontend and backend systems.
Worked directly with customers, product, and sales, building product capabilities with Node.js, React, PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch, and AWS.

projects.name: nhaccuatui.com
projects.description: Backend engineer for one of Vietnam's largest music streaming platforms, serving more than 30,000 concurrent users at peak.
responsibilities: Redesigned core backend systems around microservices and built high-traffic services with Java, Elasticsearch, Apache Kafka, Redis, and MySQL.

projects.name: Actvila & Toshiba Cloud TV
projects.description: Full-stack engineer on Japanese client projects, including Actvila and Toshiba Cloud TV, a Smart TV platform used across Europe, North America, and Japan.
responsibilities: Built backend and full-stack features with Java, Spring, Elasticsearch, Redis, MySQL, and AWS in a client-facing delivery environment.
